title: Wholesome Gooey Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: Peppery, gooey, and deliciously adventurous Turkish dish featuring turmeric powder and double-rise bread. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is a variation of the popular Iskender form.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (400°F).
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Add the sliced lamb, and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the lamb, onion, bell pepper, and tomato paste onto skewers. Brush with marinade.
Grill the kebabs for 8 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the bread on the grill for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
To assemble the Iskender, place a slice of toasted bread on a plate, then top with a few skewers of lamb, and spoon some of the juices over the top.
Repeat the layers one more time, finishing with a slice of bread on top.
Serve immediately, garnished with parsley if desired.
